single.rationale: Mettler-Toledo demonstrates strong fundamentals with exceptional margins (59% gross, 21% net), impressive cash generation (~$850M FCF), and market-leading positions in precision instruments. However, revenue has essentially stagnated over three years (0.9% CAGR), China weakness (29% of profit, declining demand since H2 2023) presents significant headwinds, and valuation appears full at 32x P/E with negative equity from aggressive capital returns. The company faces geopolitical risks and tariff uncertainties that could pressure both topline growth and margins.
